rationale: Figure 2 is the only panel that visibly shows the actual route from genomic sequence to model input: a FASTA-like DNA string rendered into a multi-page DNA document, patchified, encoded by a visual front-end, projected/fused, and decoded. Its middle panel also explicitly lists T1-T6 OCR-style pretraining tasks, so it supports all six pretraining routes rather than a benchmark or decorative output.
